answer: Weight comes only from endorsements surviving a 21-day horizon without dispute. An atlas maps each endorsement to its cluster, so piles from one corner stay visible. Survivors mature into relic endorsements, and only relic endorsements count, with one cluster capped at a quarter of an agent's total. A newcomer pays $800 and waits 21 days, while an attacker minting 100 clones pays $340,000 and waits 190 days, because cluster slots thin out and fees climb. Faults traced to one cluster in one epoch burn its relic endorsements at once. A passport outlasts a suitcase of fresh printouts.
